subject: Explain coastal gaps from TESSERA's landmask on the map page
description: Tobias asked on 2026-11-09 why a wedge is missing in Göteborg on the annual map. It is TESSERA v1's own landmask: TESSERA computes embeddings only where its generalized coastline says land, so a straight segment across the north bank of Göta älv leaves quays and river without data (evidence: ~/.agents/continuity/evidence/ImintEngine/tessera-landmask-wedge-goteborg-20261109/). He chose to explain this on the page. Page text only (docs/lclu.html); the service, r10 and the model are unchanged. Review: fresh Claude reviewer; integration needs Tobias's reviewer=human line.
